title: Jolly Cooperation
description: A modpack focused on Create and Origins!
body:
The Jolly Cooperation modpack aims to provide the player an introductory modded experience. Use Origins to help build and explore a world while creating Create contraptions!

A mostly vanilla experience with enhanced worldgen where you build factories, bedazzle them with Create Deco, and touch up your train systems with Create: Steam 'n' Rails.

Choose your starting race with Origins! Build contraptions or bases that are specific to your racial bonuse or explore the world with structure mods like Dungeons and Taverns.
